reports.title: Robots Run Faster Than Bolt! 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games Opens with Record-Breaking Performances
reports.description: The 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games opened at Beijing's National Speed Skating Hall with 666 teams and 2056 robots. TianGong Ultra ran 100m in 9.39 seconds, breaking Bolt's world record, while Glory Lightning clocked 41.95 seconds in 400m.
